描述_EN: since then his reports have been seen around the world and his commercial clients include such names as chanel, dior, vogue, harper’s bazaar, harrods and l’oréal. david downton graduated from the university of wolverhampton and began his career as a general illustrator in brighton in 1984. whilst he occasionally did fashion illustrations, it was not until 1996 when he was sent to the couture shows by the financial times that he became known as a fashion illustrator. although such deconstruction looks spontaneous, it takes dozens of drawings on layout paper to achieve a successful result. his work is distinguished by its deliberate omissions, where he draws a subject and then begins to remove details and elements until only the barest minimum remains. in 2007 he launched pourquoi pas?, the first journal to be dedicated to fashion illustration.
描述_ZN: 从那时起，他的报告在世界各地被看到，他的商业客户包括香奈儿、迪奥、《Vogue》、《Harper's bazaar》、哈罗德和欧莱雅等名字。 大卫-唐顿毕业于沃尔弗汉普顿大学，1984年在布莱顿开始了他的职业生涯，成为一名普通的插画师。 虽然他偶尔也做时尚插画，但直到1996年他被《金融时报》派去参加高级时装秀时，他才以时尚插画师的身份为人所知。 虽然这样的解构看起来是自发的，但它需要在排版纸上画几十张才能达到一个成功的结果。 他的作品以其故意的省略而闻名，他画了一个主题，然后开始删除细节和元素，直到只剩下最基本的东西。 在2007年，他推出了pourquoi pas？，第一个致力于时尚插画的杂志。
